title: AutoApply Inbox Sync State
description: Coverage model for inbox sync. [covered_low_uid, covered_high_uid] is the contiguous block of mailbox UIDs already fetched and classified; anything between horizon_uid and covered_low_uid is known-unscanned backlog. Storing an interval rather than a timestamp is what keeps a truncated sync window visible instead of silently dropped.

last_sync_at.description: Informational only — displayed in the UI. Coverage is decided by the UID fields, never by this.

uidvalidity.description: Mailbox UID generation. A change invalidates every stored UID and resets coverage.

horizon_uid.description: Oldest UID a sync will ever look at, resolved once from the lookback window.

covered_low_uid.description: Lowest UID of the contiguous covered block.

covered_high_uid.description: Highest UID of the contiguous covered block.

coverage_classifier.description: Weakest classifier that built the current covered block. Free mode filters server-side, so upgrading keyword -> llm resets coverage rather than inheriting its blind spots.

processed_message_ids.description: Ordered oldest-to-newest so capping drops the oldest, not an arbitrary member.
